#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: out address, tiles_base, tiles_extra.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto out_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t out_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t tiles_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t tiles_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = tiles_base + (core < tiles_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * tiles_base) + (core < tiles_extra ? core : tiles_extra);
    const auto out = TensorAccessor(out_args, out_addr, 2048);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_out, 1);
        noc_async_write_page(start + i, out, get_read_ptr(cb_out));
        noc_async_writes_flushed();
        cb_pop_front(cb_out, 1);
    }
    noc_async_write_barrier();
}
